title: Qaleelak Melody Kadar uddur
intro: Yalli dooreh yan taama abeynak xaqut tan goolitte ankacis. xongolo acwa lih melody, cokmi gorrisam anaakar footima, kee birta xabcinim qibaadah amri geyto qammaala. manni muuci qibaadah kee qadli madqa too astootih addat yabtam?
clues: Anu Yallih xuwaw kee meqe xongolol barkat gee.
Anu Yalli barseh sugem qadli cokmih af cedam anaakar le marih fanat.
Anu carbi addat giffole gaadule foocat garayeeh, Yallih idnil keenik eyseh.
Anu waleey, reeda kee Yallik Zabur kitaabak oobisen.
Anu qaleelaa kee kimmir yenillih bar kee ayro tawqe wak Yalla faylissa heenih engel suge.
Anu Yalli barseh faashiin koot mail birtak too yoh xabcinim.

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
